scope: One independent source and saved generated-control review. No tests, arrays, weights, native calls or production imports executed by reviewer.
findings: Native removal is restricted to full cells inside active microcapsules from previous-tip minus tip_length times axis through current-tip. The proposed physical-start-to-final-tip interval, backward length extension and radius expansion enclose the union including both spherical caps and post-exposure preentry. It does not substitute a clearance test.

The module uses the same native affine as the engine, computes full-cell world AABBs with sign-aware affine intervals, outward nextafter operations and a finite-range arithmetic allowance, and counts every intersecting positive public-target cell. This overcounts full-cell removable target potential. Fractional memberships in [0,1] are counted as one; observed free/removed cells cannot be removed again.

Unknown in-grid target coverage intersecting the envelope makes the bound unavailable even if cavity is true. Missing/unsupported inputs, excessive workspace and nonfinite reward bounds retain exact preview. Outside-grid space earns no native cell reward but is not asserted physically clear.

The canonical scorer uses nonnegative target reward and nonnegative normal/action/motion/switch penalties. Dropping normal and motion penalties raises potential reward; action and known switch costs remain, with upward rounding matching the multiplication/subtraction order. Unsupported reward signs are refused.

For positive incumbents only a strict upper-bound loss can skip a candidate; equality retains exact preview and original raw-order ties. STOP wins zero ties, so nonpositive upper bounds may skip. Newly verified feasible rewards only raise the incumbent. Final legal order remains raw catalog order.

The policy consumes explicit public target, target domain and current observed cavity. It does not use private reference membership, fit parameters for bounding, hidden tissue membership or unknown-as-empty inference. Pruned records are marked BOUND_NOT_COMPETITIVE, not geometric rejection; queried and skipped counts remain separate.

Setup, query, unavailable and pruning costs/counts are recorded. Cancellation or bound failure propagates, preserves paid work, clears partial inventory and prevents retry/publication as STOP. Existing source and immutable state checks remain in the inherited inventory path.

Saved first-attempt controls pass 20 in 0.87 seconds; owned elapsed 1.295923375 seconds, sampled child peak 90439680 bytes, exit zero and unchanged source. Controls cover caps/back extent, rotated/reflected anisotropic grids with native full-cell containment as oracle, fractional target, unknown coverage, snapshot immutability, unsupported signs/geometry, positive ties, exact generated STOP/winner/private-reference parity and interrupted bound accounting.
limitations: This establishes source/control readiness only, not measured speed or quality parity on acquired cases.

Unknown target coverage and the one-million-cell index workspace limit can prevent pruning; that is conservative fallback, not missing-coverage repair. Index construction and query overhead must be included in the actual comparison.
The bound preserves the current conditional greedy winner. It proves neither legality of skipped rays, exhaustive emitted-catalog certification, global route optimality nor clinical validity.
